title: The Agent Security Control Plane: Toward a Zero-Trust Architecture for Autonomous Machine Cognition
description: Open-source cybersecurity research proposing the Agent Security Control Plane (ASCP), a reference architecture for securing autonomous software agents through workload identity, sponsor-preserving delegation, deterministic authorization, complete mediation at network and local effect boundaries, metadata validation, provenance, revocation, behavioral monitoring, and effect-level accountability. The paper synthesizes public protocols, standards, vulnerabilities, incidents, patents, financing activity, and prior research through October 4, 2026, and presents testable synthesis claims, an explicit delegated-authority model, residual-risk boundaries, and falsifiable forecasts through 2030.
